facts.claim: Clone is React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 (+ @rive-app/react-canvas); original is Next.js + Tailwind v4 + framer-motion + embla + react-scroll-parallax + Rive
Home section order
Pricing section order; GradientBand without FeatureCards
8 sitemap slugs are soft-404s live and in Wayback; same 404 template
Unmatched paths (incl. the 8 dead slugs, which deliberately have no route) render NotFound
No scroll-reveal animations on the page
Clone has no prefers-reduced-motion handling (grep of src/ + index.html returned nothing at build time) -> all reducedMotionFallback values are prescriptive
Bold faces compute font-weight 400; unlayered rules beat utilities
Header fade 0.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1); nav container 0.3s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.35,1); items 0.6s delays 100/300/500/700ms
Header fixed after scroll (clone > 54; QA measured original >= 55)
Press 20s, family 50s reverse
Embla port: duration 25, friction .68, drag threshold 10
FAQ clouds float 10s alternate-reverse; clear skies at 20% visibility + 1000ms; 2.55s ease
Newsletter submit is prevented; no endpoint
Live AppsFlyer onelinks used by CTAs
purple1-5.svg are mascot cloud faces (white circle + lilac cloud + eyes), not photos
Blog data being written concurrently: src/data/blogPosts.json had 221 entries at snapshot; ia.json counts 221 articles (brief said 231)
During this build the blog/text/legal routes were added to the source router (routes.js renamed routes.jsx); excluded from this snapshot
PricingHero reuses HeroParallaxClouds (withBg false, opacity .7)
Clone serves 7 exact routes + 6 category routes + one article route per post in src/data/blogPosts.json (221); every other path renders the 404 template.

qaCorrections.source: Independent animation-QA pass on the live original, relayed by the coordinating session (no on-disk artifact to cite). These supersede CLONE_SPEC.md §14 where they conflict.
items: Superpower cards: no hover background change on the original; cursor auto (CLONE_SPEC M12 superseded).
Mobile menu open: original JS-driven ~264ms ease-out-like; clone 0.25s cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1) is approximate (within 0.08 normalised progress).

Featurette carousel: pointer drag follows 1:1 from anywhere on both sites (an earlier 'no follow' reading was a headless frame-starvation artifact on the original); touch swipe matches at 390 after the clone fix.
Blog image hover: original and clone both transition the CSS `scale` property to 1.05 over 0.3s.
Header becomes fixed at scrollY >= 55 on the original (clone > 54).

copyBudgets.rule: maxWords = longest real copy for the field (whitespace word count) + ~20-30% headroom.

handCheckNote: These 11 were read by eye against the cited lines (not just range/anchor) at build time; all describe the right content.

sectionHeights.measuredWith: extraction/measure_sections.mjs against the BUILT clone (npm ci; npx vite build to a scratch dir; npx vite preview), headless Chromium via Playwright, viewport 1440x900, lazy images triggered by a scroll pass.
sectionHeights.routeChoice: one representative route per template (blog-article: /blog/sleep/baby-witching-hour, the blog spec's A1 article; blog-category: /blog/sleep, which has a featured set)
sectionHeights.pageHeightNote: pageHeight = document scrollHeight. Fixed/sticky overlays (cookie consent) are not measured and take no page height. article-toc is a sticky side column beside the body at 1440 (its 900px is viewport height, not page flow).

responsiveHeights.note: Same tool, viewports 768x900 and 390x900 (R11 responsive recheck). Not gated; recorded so section contracts' responsive rules can be checked against real numbers.

typographyRecheck.note: Computed styles of the new families' key text elements in the built clone at 1440/768/390 (font family, size/line-height, weight, colour, margins). All match tokens/00-foundation/typography.json scale entries article-body/article-h2/article-h3/blog-featured-title/blog-card-title/blog-tab/blog-hero-subtitle and the h1 rule (64/72 >=992, 40/48 below).
